protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. At app tag 0.4.4, SQL-controlled tab URLs reach fmt.Sprintf(newTabScript, url) and fmt.Sprintf(setURLScript, pk, url), placing unescaped values inside AppleScript/JXA source passed to osascript -e; quote/newline input can terminate the URL literal and inject statements.

Direct fix 33769e03bd4b0f76d7a20a4188cce7153f6db1c9 is not in 0.4.4 but is an ancestor of 0.4.5; 0.4.5 carries Chrome plugin version 0.2.0 and the argv-based implementation. The BIC commit object and GitHub commit record identify human user julien040 as author and committer; the message is only '✨ Add chromium based plugin' and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI/tool marker.
